title: Implementation Plan
description: A machine-readable implementation plan. Where the project spec describes the intended system and deliberately carries no build state, this document carries build state and nothing else: numbered steps with a status, the verification gates that let a step become DONE, and the findings that changed what later phases can assume. A step is never DONE on a skipped or failed gate, and a BLOCKED step always states what failed.

targetSpec.description: Relative path to the spec document this plan builds toward.

tracks.description: Independent lines of work that may proceed in parallel. One step per track may be WORKING at a time; with no tracks declared the plan is single-threaded and exactly one step may be WORKING overall.

phases.description: The phases of the build, each owning its ordered list of steps.

gates.description: Verification gates. A step may only reach DONE once the gate for its phase has passed.

findings.description: Measured during the run, invalidating an assumption a later phase was written against. The most expensive content here to rediscover.

status.description: PENDING until started; WORKING while in progress; DONE only after the phase gate passes; BLOCKED when the gate fails or the step cannot proceed.

additionalInformation.description: Context a phase or step needs that its instruction has no slot for: a note, and optionally the source it came from.

url.description: Where the note came from. One entry per note; repeat the parent object for a second source.

description.description: What this link is, when the path alone does not say.

rationale.description: Why this work can proceed independently of the other tracks.

status.description: The phase's own status, over the same four values as a step. It summarises its steps rather than moving independently: a phase is DONE only when every one of its steps is DONE, and PENDING only while none has started. check_docs.py enforces both.

blockedReason.description: One line: what failed, and the error. Required while the phase is BLOCKED, forbidden otherwise.

additionalInformation.description: Context for the phase as a whole. Anything that only bears on one step belongs on that step instead.

steps.description: The phase's steps, in order. At most one may be WORKING: a phase belongs to a single track, and a track runs one step at a time. The plan-wide rule (one WORKING per track, across phases) cannot be counted by JSON Schema and is enforced by check_docs.py.

allOf.description: A BLOCKED phase must say what failed.
Clear the reason when the phase resumes, so a stale one cannot linger.
A PENDING phase cannot contain a step that has started.
A DONE phase cannot contain a step that is not DONE.

instruction.description: What the step asks for. Written before the work and not edited to match what happened.

outcome.description: What was actually delivered, including deviations from the instruction.

blockedReason.description: One line: what failed, and the error. Required while BLOCKED, forbidden otherwise.

dependsOn.description: Ids of steps that must be DONE first. A step whose dependency is BLOCKED stays PENDING.

additionalInformation.description: Context this step needs that the instruction does not carry: a reference, a caveat, the source a decision came from.

allOf.description: A BLOCKED step must say what failed.
Clear the reason when the step resumes, so a stale one cannot linger.

criteria.description: What must hold for the gate to pass. One entry per checkable claim.

result.description: Absent until the gate has been run.

deviation.description: Set when the gate passed but not exactly as written.

consequence.description: What this changes about the steps that follow.

discoveredIn.description: Phase id where this surfaced; omit for findings that predate the plan.
